name: EditableGrid
tagline: Editable Grid shows a list of records — a view, a sub-grid or a canvas data source — as a table you can edit directly, like a spreadsheet.
description: Editable Grid shows a list of records — a view, a sub-grid or a canvas data source — as a table you can edit directly, like a spreadsheet. You change the cells you need, the grid checks each value against the rules your app maker set, and you save all the changes in one go.
